# City of Burnaby

> > Official website for the City of Burnaby, BC, providing municipal services, business licensing, and community resources.

The City of Burnaby is British Columbia's third-largest city, offering comprehensive municipal services including business licensing, permits, community programs, and civic information. The city operates service centers including the main Licence Office at 4949 Canada Way.

## Key Topics

- City of Burnaby
- Business Licences
- Licensing Services
- 4949 Canada Way
- Burnaby BC

- Community Services

## Business Services

- [Business Licences](https://www.burnaby.ca/business/business-licences): Business licensing services and contact info at 4949 Canada Way
